scope: First restricted executable evaluator composing VOLUNDR geometry bounds, SATFLOW task 1, standard-domain incoming/outgoing limits, SATFLOW derivative and typed exchange evaluation. No production HeadCalc modification.
contract: One standard domain with no external top input, covering layer, absorption, rapid drainage or interdomain redistribution. Only wet-pore Darcy branch; dry-pore seepage is rejected rather than filled with assumed physical parameters. Input remains immutable, failed preparation returns no evaluation arrays. Geometry and matrix-zone metadata are supplied by caller; no committed state or receipt is published.
fixture: Two one-cm cells with 0.25 cm pore volume each. Pore level -0.5 cm implies initial store 0.375 cm, matrix level -1 cm implies minimum store 0.25 cm. Matrix heads [-0.5,0.5] at nodes [-0.5,-1.5] generate bottom-cell outgoing rate 0.125 cm/day. At dt=2 days, storage cap reduces rate to 0.0625 and source tangent to -0.125.
checks: Generated rate/tangent feeds trial residual/diagonal; matrix amount cancels macro storage change. Changed-dt preparation retains initial store. Unsupported dry-pore branch returns no usable evaluation. O0/O2 checked with runtime checks and floating-point traps.
limitations: No nonlinear Richards solve, matrix candidate storage, complete multi-domain physics, absorption, nonlinear backtracking or runtime/restart owner binding. Caller consistency beyond the test fixture and extreme finite arithmetic are not qualified. Derived scalar storage is diagnostic, not a full A2 continuation payload.

pore_metadata_validation.contract: Restricted wet-pore adapter requires pore_saturated_top in 1:n, finite saturation fraction in [0,1], and nonnegative reciprocal resistance in every cell, including cells skipped by saturated exchange. This is adapter input validation, not a reference formula correction or a general empty-domain contract.
pore_metadata_validation.tests: Reject top 0 and n+1 and negative resistance in the skipped unsaturated cell; restoring valid inputs succeeds. Saturated trial and nonlinear scratch gates pass O0/O2 in working tree.
pore_metadata_validation.limits: Does not derive wet-wall fraction from continuation state or prove supplied pore metadata consistent with complete source history. Production remains unbound.

derived_matrix_extension.interface: prepare_saturated_from_heads copies input and derives matrix_level/matrix_top from current heads and pond at each call before preparation. Caller matrix metadata is ignored by this entry point, but never overwritten.
derived_matrix_extension.branch_reconciliation: At an exact layer boundary CALCGWL chooses the upper containing cell even if its center is unsaturated. Wet-pore guard now skips negative-head centers, matching SATFLOW's zero difference there; nonnegative-head dry-pore branches remain rejected.
derived_matrix_extension.tests: Stale caller metadata is replaced in trial copy. Head change moves water level from -1 to -7/6 cm, changes minimum inventory to 5/24 cm, final rate to 1/6 cm/day and source tangent to -2/9 per day. Original metadata unchanged. Fully unsaturated/perched cases return no evaluation.
derived_matrix_extension.limits: Residual/system/reference scratch routes now accept optional pond to select derived metadata. No HeadCalc call site, full nonlinear solve or complete mixed-physics admission.

system_wrapper_extension.interface: evaluate_saturated_system applies residual and source diagonal contributions to local scratch copies and exposes both caller vectors, used transfer and scalar candidate storage only after both operations succeed.
system_wrapper_extension.tests: Valid paired assembly, short-diagonal failure after successful residual preparation with both caller vectors unchanged and old transfer unavailable, plus derivative-disabled branch preserving the diagonal while applying the residual.
system_wrapper_extension.ownership: Atomic numerical scratch assembly only, not a physical state commit or canonical transaction. Additional allocations are unbenchmarked; production callbacks remain unwired.

geometry_consistency_extension.contract: Restricted fixed contiguous midpoint grid: positive finite dz, pore volume between zero and dz, domain bottom equals bottom face, adjacent cell faces match, pore level inside domain, and supplied initial storage equals source VOLUNDR at that level. Reject before rate evaluation when inconsistent.
geometry_consistency_extension.tolerance: 32 machine epsilons times the relevant representation scale for coordinate/storage consistency only. No mass acceptance tolerance or solver convergence gate is changed.
geometry_consistency_extension.tests: Mismatched initial store, disconnected cell geometry, mismatched bottom and excessive pore volume return no usable evaluation. Restoring valid data reproduces original storage/rates. Existing head/retry and invalidation tests retained.
geometry_consistency_extension.limits: This adds a restricted adapter precondition, not a general B1 reference behavior change. It does not establish consistency of all supplied saturation-zone metadata with arbitrary nonlinear heads or enable moving geometry.
geometry_consistency_extension.test_result: Persisted 9da66b54d evaluator and rate-composition gates PASS O0/O2 with identical transcripts, runtime checks and floating-point traps

residual_wrapper_extension.interface: evaluate_saturated_residual composes preparation and residual application, invalidates previous used-vector scratch before any preparation, and exposes candidate scalar storage only after successful application.
residual_wrapper_extension.tests: Head 0.5 -> 0.75 -> rejected geometry -> 0.5 gives expected rates 0.125 -> 0.0625 -> unavailable -> 0.125 from unchanged input storage. residual_wrapper_extension.limitation: Matrix-zone metadata is fixed during this prescribed head sequence; it tests callback lifecycle, not dynamically derived groundwater state or a nonlinear solve. No production HeadCalc wiring or committed owner change.
